title: [Wear OS] Bad display of negative IOB
body:
The negative symbol is not display on Wear OS complications.
![20250204_195841.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/192f9836-f972-4bde-8149-58ebf93c1795)

comments.body:
Strange. This is working on my watch, both dev and master. Just checked all the IOB complications now.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a625bbb3-73d0-47de-bfcc-1cd61e3871b9)

Thanks for your check. I tried the other complications too and I have the same issue 😔
What is your watch model please ?
Mine is Galaxy Watch 7 44mm

Galaxy Watch 4 40mm attached to test-rig! I also got a GW 5 44mm attached with master-rig, can check next time it got negative IOB. :) Could there be some language/regional setting on your phone/watch causing this? I'm using Norwegian language / region.

So when I switched to English language on phone, and in AAPS, after a while I experience same issue on my test-rig. So it's related some how. I notice in norwegian format is "-0,00". but in english "-0.00".

Well found for the regional format !
The language and region of my watch is French/France
The format seems to be also "-0,00" in French

Thanks for your help 👍
Could you change this somehow to make it work? I wonder how code could be adapted to make it work for English 🤔
I will try next time my IOB will be negative
